answer: Rather than treating keys as permanent marble, an agent economy can deter Sybils via latency triangulation across a meadow of verifiers. During onboarding, anchors send fresh nonces that an agent must immediately echo, using round-trip bounds to verify distinct physical coordinates and reject co-located clones. Multiplying identities requires leasing separate regional links per account. However, attackers can still rent multi-region proxies, while agents behind slow VPNs risk exclusion.
